en: Welcome, welcome! Is this your very first time in Castelia City? I can always tell!
Every first-time visitor gets a gift from the city, and yours is a Bicycle! These avenues go on and on, you know.
Ride it anywhere outside! Up Gym Street to the north-east, there's a Pokémon Gym worth a visit, too.
Oh, you've brought a Bicycle of your own? Splendid! Then ride on, and enjoy our city!
Up Gym Street to the north-east, there's a Pokémon Gym worth a visit, too.
Castelia City never sleeps! Five streets, four piers and more towers than anyone has ever counted.
Hey, over here! Come on, come on!
If Team Plasma were hiding in Castelia, there are only two places I can think of: Narrow Street, and Thumb Pier, right down there!
Narrow Street's always crowded, so... Thumb Pier! Let's go have a look!
Thumb Pier's just down there. Hurry!
